info.title: cleanarch
info.description: CLI scaffold tool for Clean Architecture .NET solutions

commands.name: new
commands.description: Scaffold a new Clean Architecture solution.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Prints help information
none | sqlserver | postgres

options.name: --database
options.description:
none       Database provider to scaffold. Accepted values:
none | sqlserver | postgres

options.name: --output
options.description:
Directory in which the solution folder will be
created. Defaults to the current working
directory

options.name: --aspire
options.description:
Include .NET Aspire (AppHost + ServiceDefaults)
in the generated solution

arguments.name: PROJECT_NAME
arguments.description:
The PascalCase name for the generated solution (e.g.
InventorySystem)
